status: POST-HOC — not preregistered; reported as a deviation from the protocol, not as a test
question: the base scan's maximum on the holdout (b = 2.236, corrected p = 0.0005): rounding, or the population's own structure?
reading: The maximum recurs in both halves near b ≈ 2.24–2.26 (period ≈ 0.35 dex), survives a 1 % jitter (so it is not catalogue rounding) and survives a null that keeps structure down to 0.08 dex. Super-Earths (~1.3 R⊕), sub-Neptunes (~2.5 R⊕) and giants (~12 R⊕) fall near one phase of a 0.35-dex period: the known multimodal radius distribution, not a lattice. It is not φ (φ ranks 168th of 241), and no lattice at √5 is claimed — the comparison was not preregistered.
